Verify the returned value equals the number 3. Then reload the page. After the page is fully loaded and hydrated, verify that the element with data-testid="count" again shows '3'.

## Result Format
At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
{
    "status": "pass" | "fail",
    "reason": "A detailed explanation describing why the test passed or failed."
}
